cases.sentence: Господь сделал так, что Иону проглотила ___, и Иона пробыл в желудке рыбы три дня и три ночи.
cases.explain: «огромная рыба» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Then Jonah prayed to Yahweh, his God, out of the fish’s belly.

cases.sentence: На дно к ___ гор я нисшел,
cases.explain: «самым корням» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: “When my soul fainted within me, I remembered Yahweh. My prayer came in to you, into your holy temple.

cases.explain: «ничтожных идолов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: But I will sacrifice to you with the voice of thanksgiving. I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation belongs to Yahweh.”
